capabilities: Scan remote branches and commits via git fetch
Record delivery items, acceptance evidence, and release checks
Link commits to ZenTao tasks and Codex sessions
Store delivery records in a vault folder
extras: Scanning runs git fetch origin against registered remotes and may access the network; when optional Codex CLI smart linking is enabled, commit messages are sent to that service. ZenTao status reading requires a user-configured read-only client script and credentials (not bundled). Settings and delivery records are kept in plugin data (data.json), which should not be deleted on upgrade.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track software branch delivery records, linked tasks, and launch checklists alongside notes.

relations.evidence: Codex CLI：安装并在设置中指定其可执行文件后，可为提交提供智能关联建议。
禅道：可填写禅道网页地址，以便打开关联任务和 Bug。

summary: Git branch delivery manager that aggregates branches, commits, linked issues, acceptance evidence, and release checks for repositories registered in Obsidian.
